name: smwpatches-chargin-chuck-jumpover-shell
title: Chargin' Chuck Jumpover Shell
description:
Allows the Chargin' Chuck to jump over shell.
This can be applied to all Chargin' Chuck or only if Extra Bit is set to 1.(If you want to use extra bits, please apply Pixi once.)
In the case of Splittin' Chuck, the jump over shell or not setting is also inherited by the two spawned Chucks.
